resources.string: NowFocus uses this to see which app comes to the foreground, so it can block the apps you chose - during focus sessions and any Commitment Shield - and, if you turn it on, to lock your screen at your Bedtime sleep time. If you turn on partial blocking, it also reads the YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and X screens - only while a session or Commitment Shield with those options is running - to spot Shorts, Reels and recommendation lists. This feature is experimental. Nothing else on screen is read, and nothing is stored or leaves your device.
